svg.text: Missed pings by region, before and after Dispatch 4.2
Share of pings missed, by where the callout happened (region). In region = the responder pinged usually covers that region. 4.2 shipped Wed 12 Aug 2026.
Source: pings, callouts and responders tables, rook-database, 29 Jun to 6 Sep 2026 (1,696 pings). Tile text: rate, then missed / pings sent.
In region: the responder pinged usually covers the callout region
Out of region: the responder pinged usually covers a different region
Tile positions are alphabetical, not geographic: the data has region names but no coordinates. † = fewer than 10 pings, so one ping moves the rate a lot.
Before is about 6 weeks and after is about 4 weeks, so compare rates and not counts. Data stops 6 Sep 2026. Shows where misses fall, not why.
Out of region, Harborside + Old Town + Uptown: 86 pings taken after 4.2, none before. Out of region elsewhere: 108 pings, 52 missed, none taken.
